name: godot
description: Godot 4 stack pack: in-engine evidence, data-resource tunables and Godot 4 guidance.

design: In a Godot project, tunables live in custom Resource files (.tres) that the game loads, not in script constants (godot-engine).
tasks: Player-visible work in a Godot project gets an [evidence] task before any playtest task: it names the screen or state it captures and how the run reaches it, and saves under evidence/ a log from a headless run or a screenshot from a windowed or editor run or --write-movie, using a Godot MCP server when one is configured.
